preconditions.description: The length of string X must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of string Y must be between 1 and 1000.
All characters in string X must be alphabetic.
All characters in string Y must be alphabetic.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if any(c.upper() in Y for c in X) else stdout == '0'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if any uppercase version of characters in X can be found in Y, otherwise '0'.
